extension.description: Dual time zone clocks and up to five daily alarms in the VS Code status bar.
config.showTimeZoneInStatusBar: Show a short time zone label (e.g., UTC, JST) next to each clock in the status bar.
config.alarmTimeZone: Time zone used for alarm evaluation. When set to "auto", alarms use the current system time zone on each device. Choose a specific time zone to override all alarms.
config.alarmTimeZone.auto: Use the current system time zone on each device (default)
